description: This Java test class verifies the correctness of change log version lists against actual resource files in the Liquibase directory. It contains tests for snapshot and update version lists, ensuring they match the files present in specified resource patterns, and includes utility methods for name generation and resource lookup.

classes.name: ChangeLogVersionsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying Liquibase change log versions against resource files.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the ChangeLogVersions instance before each test.

methods.name: shouldGetSnapshotVersions
methods.description: Tests that snapshot versions match actual files in core data and schema-only folders.

methods.name: shouldGetUpdateVersions
methods.description: Tests that update versions match actual files in the updates folder.

methods.name: shouldGetChangeLogNameFromVersions
methods.description: Checks the correctness of change log filename generation from version list.

methods.name: compareActualAndExpectedChangeLogs
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual change log file lists.

methods.name: getChangelogNamesFromVersions
methods.description: Generates change log filenames based on a list of versions and a base name.

methods.name: lookupLiquibaseChangeLogs
methods.description: Resolves resource files matching a pattern and returns sorted filenames.
